question_record.context: A suspicious WMI process creation was observed on the machine `vnevado-win10s`. This machine has seen multiple processes such as `vssblatemp.exe`, `bcdedit`, `curl`, and a PowerShell script `get-userprttoken.ps1` being executed in a short time frame. This malware activity is known to frequently use WMI to spawn new processes and could be indicative of a further infection.
question_record.question: During this investigation, it was found that there was also a possible ransomware activity involving numerous file system changes. What is the file name of the file that was appended with a known ransomware extension?
solution: A suspicious WMI process was created on the machine using the account `dp5hn`.
Possible ransomware activity was detected where files were appended with the extension `.lockbit`, specifically `characterical.zip.lockbit`.

SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention' AND o.Concept = 'Account_Name'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s,%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
